screen.terrain_recast.title: Terrain Recast Config
screen.terrain_recast.note: Changes take effect after world reload or when joining a new world
screen.terrain_recast.import.title: Import Preset
screen.terrain_recast.import.none: No presets to import (put files in config/terrain_recast/presets/)
config.terrain_recast.terrain.mountain_a: Maximum tectonic ridge uplift (blocks). Higher = more majestic mountains.
config.terrain_recast.terrain.interior_a: Amplitude of secondary relief inside continents (blocks). Shapes plains and hills.
Ocean floor relief amplitude (blocks), keeps the abyss from being perfectly flat.
config.terrain_recast.terrain.trench_dep: Maximum downcut of subduction trenches at land-ocean boundaries (blocks).
config.terrain_recast.terrain.coast_span: Width of the land-sea transition zone (blocks). Larger = gentler coastlines.
config.terrain_recast.terrain.erosion_ro: How much old terrain rounds off ridge crests (0~1). Higher = more rounded mountains.
config.terrain_recast.terrain.min_contin: Minimum surface height on the interior of continents (blocks), prevents inland basins.
config.terrain_recast.climate.latitude_s: Latitude scale (blocks): temperature reaches minimum after this distance. Tunes polar/equator layout.
config.terrain_recast.general.spawn_land: Radius around spawn that is forced to land (blocks), keeps the spawn area on land.
command.terrain_recast.preset.apply.succ: Applied preset %s, config saved (takes effect after world reset/reload)
